title: Turbopack: retain loader tree order for metadata

target.summary: Metadata modules are imported eagerly using top-level synchronous `require()` calls instead of lazily with `() => require()`, causing runtime failures when dynamic metadata routes depend on asynchronous modules or use top-level await.
notes: faulty statement: imports metadata module synchronously using require instead of a lazy loader function
